name: Westgold Resources Limited
description: Westgold Resources Limited is a West Australian gold producer operating across the Murchison and Southern Goldfields regions, covering 3,200 square kilometres of tenements. The company is a multi-mine producer targeting over 400,000 ounces of gold annually following its August 2024 merger with Karora Resources, and maintains a primary ASX listing alongside its TSX listing under the same ticker.
